notes:
Summary: mid-market product analytics vendor building AI-powered support and in-app assistants. Started with Hosted API eval in Dec '25; strong interest in Dedicated for predictable latency and data isolation. Wants clear path from Hosted -> Dedicated with same API surface and minimal app changes.

Key contacts:
- Rajiv Menon (CTO) — technical sponsor, cares about rollback safety and audit logs. Quote: "We cannot have a POC that causes more ops churn than value. Canary with automatic rollback is a must."
- Erin Cole (Head of Product) — owns metrics and user experience, requested p95 latency targets and controlled quality checks during canary.

Technical requirements and targets:
- Workloads: chat (agent), semantic search/embeddings, doc summarization.
- Latency: chat p95 target <= 220ms in-region (US-West), conversational tail acceptable only during warm KV cache.
- Throughput: target 30-50 concurrent qps for chat; embeddings throughput batched to 10k vectors/hour.
- Quality: must match Hosted baseline (same model family), quality regression tolerance < 1.5% on product prompts.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, aiming for ARR economics in range above; POC must include cost model scenarios (autoscale, burst, steady).

Dedicated POC plan (agreed outline):
- Phase 0: confirm network peering and VPC config, security checklist (SSO, KMS, audit logging).
- Phase 1 (week 1): small canary in us-west with 2 GPU nodes, mirror 10% of traffic from Hosted for comparison.
- Phase 2 (week 2-3): expand canary to 40% if metrics stable. Evaluate KV cache hit rates, batching efficiency, and token cost.
- Phase 3 (week 4): rollback rehearsals and final runbook; region failover test (us-west -> us-east) with simulated outage.

Canary + routing/fallback specifics:
- Model variants: primary 13B fp16 quantized variant for cost; fallback to full 13B fp16 (higher perf) and Hosted API (same model family) for capacity overflow.
- Routing policy: traffic weight and latency-based routing with SLA floor; automatic fallback to Hosted API when Dedicated GPU queue > 500ms or KV cache cold-start > threshold.
- Rollback: automated circuit-breaker after 5 consecutive p95 breaches or error rate delta > 2x baseline; immediate route shift back to Hosted and alerting to on-call SE.
- Region failover: scripted cutover plan to us-east with DNS TTL and session affinity preservation; metrics to validate (latency, error budget, token counts).

Security/compliance notes:
- RH needs SOC2 evidence and ISO inquiry; legal sent DPA redlines 2026-02-28.
- Data residency: PII persisted only in customer DB; model inputs logged for monitoring but flagged for retention controls — retention window negotiation pending.

POC success criteria (customer-defined):
- Functional parity with Hosted on canonical prompt set (eval harness pass rate >= 98%).
- p95 chat latency <= 220ms during peak simulation for 30 qps.
- Cost model shows >= 15% improvement vs naive Hosted topology at projected steady state.
- Security controls validated: SSO, KMS integration complete, audit logs available in customer's SIEM.
